subject: Burnout Revenge Now on Games on Demand!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Burnout Revenge has now been added to the Games on Demand service. This means that both 360 Burnout games are now available on demand, you can just download them straight to your hard drive without needing a disc.

The price of Games on Demand and the memory resource required is probably enough to put most people off, but if you have a large HDD and money is no object for you, this could be the future of gaming! 🙂
